description: 20 labelled PR snapshots (Python / TypeScript / Java). truth.rule_key='any' = line-level matching so the same cases can score the deterministic engine and the OCR engine. Geometry convention: hunk starts at line 1 (or 10), context line then the added line, so the added line is at start+1.

cases.name: eval 任意代码执行
cases.diff:
diff --git a/app/mod.py b/app/mod.py
--- a/app/mod.py
+++ b/app/mod.py
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 def handle(user_input):
+    return eval(user_input)
